gloss: outside Tokyo; outside the metropolitan area

definitions.gloss: outside Tokyo; outside the metropolitan area
definitions.explanation: Areas outside Tokyo Metropolis, used in administrative, news, and everyday contexts when distinguishing between inside and outside the capital.

examples.japanese: {都外|とがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
{都外|とがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: Commuting from outside Tokyo takes time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}→在宅勤務：06158_zaitakukinmu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{都外|とがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: With the spread of remote work, more people are living outside Tokyo.

notes:
Composed of {都|と} (metropolis, specifically Tokyo) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). Follows the same pattern as ⟦{都内|とない}→都内：19144_tonai⟧ (inside Tokyo). The {都|と} in this word specifically refers to {東京都|とうきょうと} (Tokyo Metropolis), not to any other city.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都外|とがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live outside Tokyo
- {都外|とがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧: commuting from outside Tokyo
- {都外|とがい}⟦{移転|いてん}→移転：04000_iten⟧: relocation outside Tokyo

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{都内|とない}→都内：19144_tonai⟧: inside Tokyo — the opposite; refers to areas within Tokyo Metropolis
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧: suburbs — refers to outlying areas of any city, not specifically Tokyo
- {県外|けんがい}: outside the prefecture — the equivalent term for prefectures other than Tokyo
